slots.ask: Who are you in the story, and where does it happen?
slots.why: The hero and the world set every scene, the choices that make sense, and the art.
slots.extrapolate_from: a named character, franchise, place or role in the request ("Princess Leia", "a stray cat", "a medieval peasant")
slots.ask_when: the request names no hero, role or world at all

slots.ask: What is the mystery: who did it, what is missing, or what really happened?
slots.why: The case decides the clues (items and flags), the suspects and which ending counts as solving it.
slots.extrapolate_from: the crime, the missing thing or the question in the request

slots.ask: How many clues do you need before you can accuse someone?
slots.why: Sets the clue threshold that gates the right accusation, and so how hard the case is.
slots.extrapolate_from: easy, hard, quick, daily in the request

slots.ask: Should people from your Group be in the story?
slots.why: A Group cast makes the story about specific friends; only names and details given in the request are used.
slots.extrapolate_from: "starring our group", "my friends", names in the request, or a Group target in Studio
choices: yes, the Group as side characters

slots.ask: Should it feel funny, epic or tense?
slots.why: Tone sets the voice of every scene, how harsh bad endings are, and the look and sound.
slots.extrapolate_from: words like brainrot, silly, epic, spooky, cozy, or the franchise's usual tone

slots.why: One style sheet drives every picture Muse Image draws for the game (sprites, backdrop, portraits, scene pictures), so they all match: palette, line, lighting and framing.
slots.extrapolate_from: an art-style word in the request (pixel art, 8-bit, retro RPG, watercolor, Ghibli, LEGO, claymation, anime, 80s anime, comic, low poly, papercraft, neon, crayon), else the franchise's own look
slots.ask_when: the request names no art style and the game is art-heavy (the plan has art: "image": a story with characters, or three or more sprite roles); otherwise Muse picks one and says so in the anatomy ("I'm drawing it as bold cartoon art")
slots.notes: The planner fits the choices to the theme (3-4, plus Other). Shared definition: checklists/shared/art_style.json.

notes: Choice-driven mysteries use branching_story: clues are items or a clue stat, the accusation routes on them.
